about: Every asset in PAE-02 SCION 12. Nothing was taken from the kit, the archive, the web or a model: every shape is drawn in code (polygons, unions and pierced holes), every weight is solved here, every sound is synthesized here.

assets.what: the dog: one cut-paper (papercut) profile with 34 pierced lace holes, legs and ears a finger apart, curled tail
assets.source: build/dog.py (drawn in code as unions of tapered strokes and a Catmull-Rom torso, holes as petals, circles and slits)
assets.operation: drawn; constrained Delaunay triangulation (triangle library); bounded biharmonic weights solved in build/bbw.py

assets.what: 12 bones (neck, head, 2 per leg, 2 tail), 2 point handles (ear tips), a 6-vertex torso cage
assets.operation: computed: per-handle affines from the score's acting state; linear blend skinning

assets.what: the person: ink-blue cut paper, long coat with pierced hem, rosette, coat vent
assets.operation: drawn; triangulated; bounded biharmonic weights (8 bones, 1 point, 4-vertex coat cage)

assets.what: room with lace wallpaper, lamp, picture, rug; door leaf; wall section hatched in pierced slots; sill; porch floor, lattice skirt, scalloped fascia, roof with gingerbread trim, post, steps; sky, stars, moon, hills and trees
assets.operation: drawn in code as polygons with holes; procedural paper-fibre texture (numpy noise)

assets.what: the person's lines (Come here. x2, It's all right. x2, Come in.)
assets.source: build/sound.py speak(): sawtooth glottal source through three time-varying formant resonators, phoneme targets typed by hand

assets.what: paper footfalls on each paw plant (same gait as the picture), paper rustles on each yaw ripple and on lying down, door latch and creak, stool creak, crickets, dusk air, warm pad when the light comes out
Literata (captions), Big Shoulders Display (title), JetBrains Mono (numbers)
assets.source: tools/paeleo/fonts/*.woff2 (shared in the repo), converted to TTF in build/cache/fonts
assets.operation: type set on the captions and cards

assets.what: the dog's decision trace (timing, x, acting state, the person's circumstances, the door)

not_used: kit/archive-dog, kit/archive-door, Quick, Draw!, found-frames: none of them are in this film.
